instruction: Configure Thunderbird to receive emails for privacy2024@gmail.com without setting up an outgoing (SMTP) server.

metadata.explanation: This is an infeasible task variation. While the original asks to send without incoming service, this variation asks to receive without outgoing service. Thunderbird's account setup requires both incoming and outgoing servers to be configured for a functional email account. Attempting to configure only incoming (POP3/IMAP) without SMTP would result in an incomplete account that cannot be properly saved.
